title: Water Leak Work Order Form
subtitle: An original water leak workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete water leak work order form for the suspected or confirmed water-release location that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The leak response coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Water leak work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Water leak asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact suspected or confirmed water-release location and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Confirm leak location, reporter, time, flow status, and affected areas
Screen electrical, structural, contamination, slip, and public hazards
Identify likely source without opening unsafe or unauthorized systems
Coordinate authorized shutoff and critical-service consequences
Record meter, flow, pressure, moisture, and visual evidence
Contain water and protect occupants or property within approved scope
Repair the confirmed source or route it to the correct qualified trade
Verify flow stopped and record post-repair or post-isolation readings
Assign drying, electrical, environmental, finish, and contents follow-up
Monitor for recurrence and document final service and property handoff

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Water leak pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter water near electrical equipment, stand below a sagging ceiling, or handle suspected contaminated water. Keep occupants clear and use the organization's emergency route for rapid flooding, structural movement, gas odor, or critical-service impact. Only authorized personnel may operate shutoffs after evaluating downstream consequences. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Water leak work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Water leak exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Water contacting electrical equipment, outlets, panels, cords, or machinery
Bulging or sagging ceiling, unstable finish, structural movement, or falling material
Suspected sewage, chemical, fire-water, or other contaminated release
Rapid flooding, washout, sinkhole, severe pressure, or uncontrolled flow
Slip exposure, hidden opening, poor visibility, or unsafe access
Shutoff would impair fire protection, medical, process, or critical service
Gas odor, steam, hot water, refrigerant, or unknown fluid is also present
Condition exceeds responder authority, equipment, training, or protective controls
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter water near electrical equipment, stand below a sagging ceiling, or handle suspected contaminated water. Keep occupants clear and use the organization's emergency route for rapid flooding, structural movement, gas odor, or critical-service impact. Only authorized personnel may operate shutoffs after evaluating downstream consequences.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Water leak decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Suspected or confirmed water-release location identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
